tool_args.rationale: The base-field, sink-gradient, and transient-lag signatures favor the siphon-memory ODE. The fine trajectory batch is the only relevant probe on the menu and supplies the additional observations needed to constrain the five parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations at similar horizons leave no residual degrees of freedom and may not separate the fast memory time constant from the coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb-Douglas law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model accounts for the initial state, stored memory, and forecast horizon implicated by the coupled-transient signature.
The auxiliary measurement does not help identify the coupled dynamics.
